neighbours.label: a process noun by which a substance is produced or transformed (refining, electrolysis, distillation, decomposition, weathering)
fire: Most copper is purified by electrolysis in large tanks.
Sugar is extracted from cane by crushing and boiling the stalks.
Whisky gets its strength through distillation of fermented grain.
The cliffs were shaped by erosion over thousands of years.
Steel is made by smelting iron ore with coke.
Compost forms through the decomposition of leaves and food scraps.
Fresh water can be produced by desalination of seawater.
Ethanol is made by fermentation of corn sugar.
quiet: Most copper is shipped to factories in large trucks.
Sugar from cane is sold in shops across the country.
Whisky is often served with a little water.
The cliffs are home to thousands of nesting birds.
Steel is used in bridges, cars and buildings.
Compost is spread on the garden beds in spring.
Fresh water is stored in tanks on the roof.
Ethanol is added to petrol at many gas stations.

notes: Card: refining, reforming, decomposition, weathering, adds (chlorine), electrolyse. Probes 0.5-0.69.
